premises.text: Open source software often has bugs and missing features that are hard to get support for
premises.evidence_span: all this software has two properties in common, which is bugs and missing features. And especially when it's open or free software, support can be hard to get.

premises.text: There is a mismatch in knowledge and priority between users and developers regarding software support
premises.evidence_span: there's a mismatch in knowledge and priority between the user and the developer.

premises.text: Users can place incentives for software support directly from an issue page
premises.evidence_span: we are offering a service which allows you to pay or get paid directly from an issue page.

premises.text: Crowdfunding for bug fixes and feature requests is possible through the platform
premises.evidence_span: crowdfunding is now a reality. Crowdfunding on bug and features.

premises.text: Integrations with major issue systems can facilitate the placement of incentives
premises.evidence_span: we offer integrations for all the major issue systems.

premises.text: The platform can turn issue systems into profit centers for their hosters
premises.evidence_span: we offer a fee to all the issue system hosters running our integration, which turns an issue system into a profit center.

premises.text: The open source market is large and expanding, with a measurable size of 8 billion
premises.evidence_span: the measurable size alone is like 8 billion, which is huge.

value.text: Users can get the support they need for open source software more easily
value.evidence_span: imagine a world where it's possible to get the support you really need or where it's easy to get something improved.

notes: No traction metrics or external partnerships coded.
